newsitem.title: USA: Sled Dogs says to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Sled Dogs says to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Sled Dogs Co, which makes snow skates, said Wednesday its stock will be delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market effective with the close of business on Thursday.
The company indicated that it wasn't able to meet current Nasdaq listing standards of a minimum bid price of at least $1, or capital and surplus of $2 million or more.
After June 19, 1997, the company's common stock will trade on the Nasdaq over-the-counter Bulletin Board, the company said.
